html:
.grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 420px), 1fr));
  gap: 24px;
  width: 100%;
}

.card {
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: clip;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: var(--background);
  scroll-margin-top: 140px;
}

.cardHeader {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 24px;
}

.cardTitle {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.index {
  font: 12px monospace;
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  align-self: flex-start;
  padding-top: 4px;
}
.cardTitle h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.5px;
}
.cardTitle p {
  margin: 5px 0 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}
.reset {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--background);
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.reset:hover {
  color: var(--primary);
  background: var(--muted);
}
.reset:focus-visible,
.viewport:focus-visible,
.snapControls button:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
  outline-offset: -3px;
}

.viewport {
  position: relative;
  height: 300px;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted-foreground) 40%, transparent)
    transparent;
  border-block: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.cardFooter {
  padding: 20px 24px 22px;
}
.cardFooter > p {
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}
.technique {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 5px 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: var(--muted);
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  font: 10px/1.5 monospace;
}
.micro {
  font: 9px/1.6 monospace;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}
.eyebrow {
  font: 9px/1.6 monospace;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px;
}
.hint {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  font-size: 10px;
  opacity: 0.75;
}
.endNote {
  padding: 24px 0;
  text-align: center;
  font: 10px/1.8 monospace;
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}

.revealViewport {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 5%, var(--background));
}
.revealIntro {
  padding: 34px 28px 24px;
}
.revealIntro .eyebrow {
  color: var(--success);
}
.revealIntro h3 {
  margin: 16px 0 18px;
  font-size: 23px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: -1px;
}
.revealList {
  display: grid;
  gap: 18px;
  padding: 0 24px 12px;
}
.revealItem {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 24px;
  min-height: 145px;
  padding: 24px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 15%, var(--border));
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--background);
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
  transition:
    opacity 700ms ease,
    transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1);
}
.revealViewport[data-motion="ready"] .revealItem[data-visible="false"] {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(28px);
}
.revealMark {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 64px;
  height: 64px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 8%, var(--background));
  color: var(--success);
  font-size: 42px;
  line-height: 1;
}
.revealItem .micro {
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}
.revealItem h4 {
  margin: 8px 0 5px;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.revealItem p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}

.readingViewport {
  background: var(--background);
}
.readingToolbar {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  height: 39px;
  padding: 0 24px;
  background: var(--background);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.readingToolbar > .micro {
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}
.readingPercent {
  font: 10px monospace;
  color: var(--primary);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.progressTrack {
  position: absolute;
  inset: auto 0 -1px;
  height: 3px;
  background: var(--muted);
}
.progressFill {
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--primary);
  transform-origin: left;
}
.readingArticle {
  padding: 30px 32px 0;
}
.readingArticle > .eyebrow {
  color: var(--primary);
}
.readingArticle h3 {
  margin: 15px 0;
  font-size: 31px;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.4;
  letter-spacing: -1.5px;
}
.readingLead {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  line-height: 1.9;
}
.readingArt {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  height: 200px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 24px 0 28px;
  padding: 24px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #e7e1f5;
  color: #4a3874;
}
.readingArt > span {
  z-index: 1;
  font:
    36px/0.95 Georgia,
    serif;
  letter-spacing: -1px;
}
.readingArt i {
  font-weight: 400;
}
.readingArt > div {
  position: absolute;
  right: 10%;
  width: 130px;
  height: 190px;
  border: 28px solid #a99ac7;
  border-radius: 90px;
  transform: rotate(30deg);
}
.readingArticle section {
  padding: 10px 0 16px;
}
.readingArticle h4 {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.readingArticle section p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 2.1;
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}

.parallaxViewport {
  background: #dde9e6;
}
.parallaxScene {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 800px;
  overflow: clip;
}
.parallaxBackground {
  position: absolute;
  inset: -100px 0;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #d9e7eb, #e5ece4 46%, #9cae99);
  will-change: transform;
}
.sun {
  position: absolute;
  top: 150px;
  right: 18%;
  width: 74px;
  height: 74px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #f6dfaa;
  box-shadow: 0 0 80px #f6dfaa70;
}
.mountainBack,
.mountainFront {
  position: absolute;
  display: block;
  inset: 220px -20% -20%;
  background: #8ca79c;
  clip-path: polygon(
    0 26%,
    14% 13%,
    28% 23%,
    50% 0,
    69% 22%,
    80% 12%,
    100% 24%,
    100% 100%,
    0 100%
  );
}
.mountainFront {
  inset: 340px -15% -20%;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #597f73, #345d50);
  clip-path: polygon(
    0 19%,
    22% 0,
    38% 13%,
    64% 5%,
    77% 25%,
    100% 10%,
    100% 100%,
    0 100%
  );
}
.parallaxForeground {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  padding: 55px 32px 45px;
  color: #254c42;
}
.landscapeLabel {
  font: 9px monospace;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
}
.parallaxForeground > h3 {
  margin: 24px 0 25px;
  font-size: 40px;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.25;
  letter-spacing: -2px;
}
.landscapeNote {
  margin-top: 245px;
  padding: 24px;
  border: 1px solid #ffffff40;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #f0f3eae8;
  color: #254c42;
}
.landscapeNote h4 {
  margin: 14px 0;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: -1px;
}
.landscapeNote p {
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.9;
}
.speedBadge {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding: 5px 8px;
  border: 1px solid #254c4230;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font: 10px/1.6 monospace;
}

.contactsViewport {
  background: var(--background);
}
.contactsIntro {
  padding: 24px;
}
.contactsIntro .micro {
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}
.contactsIntro h3 {
  margin: 12px 0 6px;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.contactsIntro p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}
.contactGroup {
  position: relative;
}
.stickyLetter {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  height: 36px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0 24px;
  border-block: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--muted);
}
.stickyLetter > span:first-child {
  font: 14px monospace;
  color: var(--primary);
}
.stickyLetter > span:last-child {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
  font-weight: 400;
}
.contact {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  height: 69px;
  padding: 0 24px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.avatar {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 35px;
  height: 35px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 9%, var(--background));
  color: var(--primary);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.avatar[data-color="1"] {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 9%, var(--background));
  color: var(--success);
}
.avatar[data-color="2"] {
  background: var(--muted);
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}
.contact p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.contact div > span {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}
.contactDot {
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  margin-left: auto;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--success);
}

.snapDemo {
  position: relative;
}
.snapViewport {
  scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
}
.snapSlide {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 100%;
  padding: 22px 28px 48px;
  scroll-snap-align: start;
  scroll-snap-stop: always;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.snapSlide[data-tone="peach"],
.horizontalCard[data-tone="peach"] {
  background: #f5e3d5;
  color: #704631;
}
.snapSlide[data-tone="sage"],
.horizontalCard[data-tone="sage"] {
  background: #e0e9db;
  color: #3c5a40;
}
.snapSlide[data-tone="lilac"],
.horizontalCard[data-tone="lilac"] {
  background: #e5dff2;
  color: #52416f;
}
.horizontalCard[data-tone="blue"] {
  background: #dbe6f0;
  color: #3c546f;
}
.snapNumber {
  font: 10px monospace;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  opacity: 0.8;
}
.snapMark {
  position: absolute;
  top: -25px;
  right: 22px;
  font:
    175px/1.2 Georgia,
    serif;
  opacity: 0.17;
}
.snapWord {
  position: relative;
  font-size: clamp(24px, 5vw, 38px);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -1.5px;
}
.snapSlide h3 {
  margin: 6px 0 7px;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.snapSlide p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.8;
}
.snapControls {
  position: absolute;
  inset: auto 24px 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.snapControls button {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 25px;
  height: 25px;
  border: 1px solid #00000020;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #ffffff55;
  color: #493f42;
  cursor: pointer;
  pointer-events: auto;
}
.snapControls button:disabled {
  opacity: 0.25;
  cursor: default;
}
.snapDots {
  display: flex;
  gap: 5px;
}
.snapDots button {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
}
.snapDots span {
  width: 5px;
  height: 5px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #493f4250;
}
.snapDots button[aria-pressed="true"] span {
  width: 14px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: #493f42;
}

.horizontalViewport {
  background: #262530;
  color: #f4f1fb;
}
.horizontalRunway {
  position: relative;
}
.horizontalSticky {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  height: 298px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.horizontalLabel {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 22px 24px 18px;
  color: #b8b3c6;
}
.horizontalLabel > span:last-child {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  font-size: 10px;
}
.horizontalTrack {
  display: flex;
  gap: 14px;
  width: max-content;
  padding: 0 24px;
  will-change: transform;
}
.horizontalCard {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  width: 208px;
  height: 221px;
  padding: 20px;
  border-radius: 9px;
}
.horizontalMark {
  align-self: center;
  font:
    72px/1 Georgia,
    serif;
}
.horizontalCard h3 {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.horizontalCard p {
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  font-size: 10px;
  opacity: 0.75;
}
.horizontalViewport[data-reduced-motion="true"] {
  overflow-x: auto;
  overflow-y: hidden;
}
.horizontalViewport[data-reduced-motion="true"] .horizontalSticky {
  position: relative;
  width: max-content;
  min-width: 100%;
  overflow: visible;
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .cardHeader {
    padding: 20px;
  }
  .cardTitle h2 {
    font-size: 15px;
  }
  .cardFooter {
    padding: 18px 20px 20px;
  }
  .revealIntro {
    padding-inline: 22px;
  }
  .revealIntro h3 {
    font-size: 21px;
  }
  .revealList {
    padding-inline: 18px;
  }
  .revealItem {
    padding: 18px;
    gap: 16px;
  }
  .revealMark {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    font-size: 32px;
    border-radius: 12px;
  }
  .readingArticle {
    padding-inline: 24px;
  }
  .parallaxForeground {
    padding-inline: 24px;
  }
  .landscapeNote {
    padding: 20px;
  }
  .landscapeNote h4 {
    font-size: 18px;
  }
  .horizontalLabel {
    padding-inline: 18px;
  }
  .horizontalLabel .micro {
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .revealViewport[data-motion="ready"] .revealItem[data-visible="false"] {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
  .revealItem {
    transition: none;
  }
  .parallaxBackground,
  .horizontalTrack {
    will-change: auto;
  }
}
